verdict.rationale: Llama is an open-weights model family. The evidence covers model downloads, the CLI, runtimes, function calling and safety classifiers. Nothing shows a first-party in-product feature that analyzes a user's own data and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions. Model capabilities like function calling and agent-optimized inference are developer building blocks for building such a feature, not the feature itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
